The overnight dispatcher wants the **Fleet Return Exceptions** report sorted by arrival time, not vehicle ID. Current export is technically usable, in the same sense that a stapler can be a paperweight.

## Current follow-up

On Oct 1, dispatch flagged duplicate appointment rows after a late shift handoff. Ticket PD-7318 has the screenshots; one is sideways, naturally. Gideon Sato is collecting the affected appointment IDs before support tries to reproduce it.
